tool.name: RADAR-PD Diagnostic: CUDA trainer acceptance
tool.description: verify actual GPU kernels, recovery and portable inference using fixed synthetic controls
tool.command: export CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 RADAR_PREPARATION_TRAINING_DEVICE=cuda OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 && export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="\${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES-0}" && touch '$result_bundle' '$console_output' && trap "chmod a+r '$result_bundle' '$console_output' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true" EXIT && python '$runtime_probe' >> '$console_output' 2>&1 && python /opt/radar-symmetry/ndip_preparation_cuda_acceptance.py acceptance '$result_bundle' >> '$console_output' 2>&1

configfiles.configfile: import json, os, shutil, subprocess import torch from gpx_recipe.symmetry.resources import allocation record=dict(schema='radar-cuda-routing-probe/v1',torch=str(torch.__version__),cuda_build=torch.version.cuda, cuda_available=torch.cuda.is_available(),cuda_devices=torch.cuda.device_count(), application_binding=os.environ.get('CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES'),allocation=allocation(4), exclusive_gpu_reservation_claimed=False) binary=shutil.which('nvidia-smi') if binary: try: result=subprocess.run([binary,'--query-gpu=name,driver_version,memory.total,memory.free,utilization.gpu', '--format=csv,noheader'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5) record['visible_driver_status']=result.stdout[:4096] if result.returncode==0 else result.stderr[:1024] except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:record['visible_driver_status']='Probe timed out' print('[RADAR CUDA ROUTING] '+json.dumps(record,sort_keys=True))

tool.help:
Runs the installed, fixed synthetic controls on one usable CUDA device. All seven hardware tests must pass without skips. A visible NVIDIA device or a successful wrapper alone does not qualify training. No experimental inputs, credentials or uploaded code are accepted.
The application retains the worker's CUDA binding, or limits itself to the first visible device when no binding was supplied. It caps its Torch allocator at 4 GiB. That application limit does not establish an exclusive GPU reservation. Resource requirements express routing needs; runtime receipts separately record the actual device and CPU allocation. A CPU destination fails explicitly.
